subject: Renewal kickoff: phased capacity uplift, owners, and QBR availability
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novacorp.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift and timeline

Marcus / Grace —

As we approach our Nov 30 renewal, leadership is asking for a clear plan for a phased capacity uplift tied to our new feature rollout. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether we can sustain a 2x token throughput for Q4 (short spike for holiday traffic)
- Outline a migration/rollout timeline with owners for any tier changes
- Share a proposed QBR slot in the next two weeks so execs can join

I've attached a short usage extract (current_usage_report.csv) and added Amit in case we need more telemetry. We would like to kick off a mutual action plan and get legal/finance checklist items surfaced early.

Can your team propose 2 QBR windows and an initial timeline this week?

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaCorp
Attachments: current_usage_report.csv (CSV)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift and timeline

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear asks. Proposed next steps below and a couple of windows for the QBR:

1) QBR availability (pick one):
   - Wed Aug 3, 10:00–11:00 PT (prefered)
   - Fri Aug 5, 08:00–09:00 PT
2) High-level initial timeline (we'll flesh out owners in the MAP doc):
   - Week of Aug 7: scoping & traffic pattern review (RE internal: Grace + Connor; customer: Priya + Amit)
   - Week of Aug 14: commit proposal (pricing + term options) and technical runbook draft
   - Week of Aug 21: legal & finance kickoff; finalize SLA/quant terms
   - Sept: staged rollout and performance validation; target Nov 1 full uplift in production
3) Owners: Marcus — executive sponsor and commercial; Grace — technical lead / performance validation; Vanessa — contract & pricing; Connor — implementation runbook and ops cadence.
Attached: NovaCorp_Mutual_Action_Plan_v0.1.docx (initial skeleton).

If the Wed slot works, I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda (brief exec readout, technical deep dive, mutual action plan review). We will also bring a short demo of the autoscaling/burst capability.

Marcus Lin
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachments: NovaCorp_Mutual_Action_Plan_v0.1.docx (DOCX)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift and timeline

Priya — quick technical clarifications ahead of the QBR / scoping:

- The 2x sustained throughput request: can you share the token-per-second distribution across your busiest endpoints? Peak vs 95th percentile will change batching strategy. The CSV you sent helps but if you can add per-endpoint delta that'd be ideal.
- We recommend a staged uplift: a) reserved headroom for steady-state (committed capacity), b) burst pool for seasonal traffic, and c) pre-warm period 48–72 hours before big pushes.
- For the migration runbook: Connor will own the KV cache migration steps and test checklist; I'm owning latency regression thresholds and perf signoff criteria.

Also adding a legal/finance checklist for your team to review prior to Aug 21:
- Term and billing cadence options (annual vs stair-step)
- Data residency and audit log retention confirmation
- SLA targets (99.9% vs 99.95%) and credit structure
I'll attach a short pre-read (QBR agenda + checklist) to the calendar invite. Marcus — when you send the invite, can you include links to the perf dashboards and the shared Drive folder?

Grace O'Connor
Technical Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novacorp.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift and timeline

Thanks Marcus / Grace — Wed Aug 3 at 10:00 PT works for our execs. Please include our CTO and Head of Ops; I'll confirm names tomorrow.

Action items for the meeting:
- Marcus: calendar invite + QBR agenda and shared Drive link (please include MAP doc)
- Grace: 15–20 minute tech deep dive + perf dashboards and preliminary uplift plan
- Vanessa: initial pricing options and term tradeoffs (we prefer to see an annual and a staircase model)
- Connor: runbook outline and required telemetry for validation

We'll upload a short pre-read by EOD Monday — should contain endpoint-level throughput and a short list of traffic gating constraints. Please flag anything you need from legal/finance ahead of the Aug 21 checkpoint.

Looking forward —
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, NovaCorp
Attachments: usage_scenarios.pdf (PDF)
